payload.title: The core components' fixed words are interface strings, so a language edition shows none in English
payload.description:
As a Spanish reader of a site that does not draw its own body, I want the skip link, the menu button and the Newer and Older paging links in Spanish. Today components.py writes 'Skip to main content', 'Menu', 'Newer', 'Older' and the page-actions labels in English. Move them into the interface strings (projection/standard/interface_strings.py) as engine keys core.skipLink, core.menu, core.newer, core.older and core.pageActions.*; a public language must have them (the completeness check names any missing).

Feature: Core words in the page's language
  Scenario: The paging links of a Spanish listing are in Spanish
    Given a Spanish edition whose interface strings name core.newer and core.older
    When its second listing page is rendered
    Then the paging links read the Spanish words and no English word appears
